title: His sultan tried to kill him. Then what? | Folio 7 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
The secret did not stay secret, and the plot fell apart. The next section of Beyhaqi's book has a short and grim title. The killing of Qaid Malanjuq. The man who was meant to strike the blow did not survive it. Altuntash was alive, and he knew. Now we come to the dangerous moment. An old general with an army has just learned that his sultan tried to murder him. What would you expect him to do?

The full story: Folio 7: The Secret Order Against the Loyal General — on our channel and on every podcast app.
